string.text: Master switch. Slowly restores overall health based on limb condition.
Overall HP restored per in-game hour while every limb is at maximum. 0.10 = 10% per hour.
Overall HP restored per in-game hour while limbs are damaged but not badly hurt. 0.03 = 3% per hour.
Below this share of total limb points (or with a broken limb, or head/torso below the core minimum) there is no natural recovery. Default 60.
Head and torso need at least this many points (of 11) for the damaged rate. Default 6.
Natural recovery stops at your limb condition. Example: limbs at 75% means HP recovers up to 75%; meds are needed above that.
Each hour of sleep heals 1 limb point (GAMMA) and then applies the matching recovery rate.
Real seconds after taking damage before recovery resumes. Default 60.
No natural recovery while you have an open wound.
No recovery while satiety is below this value. 0 disables the hunger check. Default 0.15.
No recovery at this thirst indicator level or worse (1 grey - 4 red). 5 disables the check. Default 3 (orange).
No recovery while radiation is above this value. 1 disables the check. Default 0.10.
Write sleep recovery amounts to the game log.
